title: Sorting an Array
prompt:
Write a program to sort an array of integers in ascending order
Sample Input: [5, 2, 8, 1, 9]
Sample Output: [1, 2, 5, 8, 9]
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that sorts an array of integers in ascending order using the built-in `sort()` method:

```python
sample_input = [5, 2, 8, 1, 9]
sample_input.sort()
print(sample_input)
```

When you run this program, it will output:

```
[1, 2, 5, 8, 9]
```

If you want to sort the array in-place (i.e., without creating a new list), you can use the `sort()` method directly on the array:

```python
sample_input = [5, 2, 8, 1, 9]
sample_input.sort()
print(sample_input)
```

This will also output:

```
[1, 2, 5, 8, 9]
```

I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions.
